list.name: node_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT node_id FROM tessellation_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY node_id

list.name: network_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT network_id FROM tessellation_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY network_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT node_id) AS value FROM tessellation_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT count() / (dateDiff('second', min(timestamp), max(timestamp)) / 60) AS value FROM tessellation_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT count(DISTINCT metric_name) AS value FROM tessellation_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT max(value) AS value FROM tessellation_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'dag_global_snapshot_ordinal' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 15 SECOND) AS time, substring(node_id, 1, 8) AS node, max(value) AS value FROM tessellation_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'dag_global_snapshot_ordinal' AND timestamp BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND ($__conditionalAll(node_id IN ($node_id), $node_id)) GROUP BY time, node ORDER BY time
